model_hint: qwen-image (text->image) / qwen-image-edit (图生图，一次只改一件事)
prompt_order: 质量词 -> 画风 -> 角色锚点 -> 景别/动作 -> 配色与背景。风格与角色锚点任何一条被截断都会认不出人。
pairing_rule: 动漫组四条共用同一段 style_lead；豆包组共用同一段 hand_drawn_lead。同一组内只换角色锚点与动作段。
cleaning: 生成时先出 deepseek_r1 的 standee 作为定稿基准，其余角色对齐它的线宽、眼睛画法与光影强度，再出 Q 版和 gaming。

anime.style_lead: anime key visual, clean cel shading, soft rim light, crisp lineart, 2D illustration, high detail
anime.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, realistic skin, blurry, lowres, extra fingers, deformed hands, text, watermark, signature, multiple characters, cropped head, busy background

hand_drawn.note: 豆包阵营与动漫组在媒介上就分开：不做赛璐璐、不做高光、不做长睫毛，一眼可辨。
hand_drawn.negative: anime, cel shading, glossy highlights, long eyelashes, photorealistic, 3d render, text, watermark, multiple characters, busy background
